hooks.command:
project_dir="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; if ! cd "$project_dir"; then printf '%s
' 'WARNING: could not inspect the devmatrix working tree.' >&2; exit 0; fi; if ! changes="$(git status --short 2>&1)"; then printf '%s
' 'WARNING: could not inspect the devmatrix working tree.' "$changes" >&2; exit 0; fi; if [ -n "$changes" ]; then printf '%s
' 'WARNING: devmatrix has uncommitted changes.' 'If the user requested commit, push, deploy, go live, publish, or ship, complete the full AGENTS.md release chain before stopping.' "$changes" >&2; else printf '%s
' 'devmatrix working tree is clean.'; fi
